{{Quote|It may be a tight squeeze, but you'll survive to complain about it over Chandrilan herb tea later.|Advertisement for the EMS-90 bubble cloak in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
'''Chandrilan herb tea''' was a type of [[Tisane|herbal tea]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> that shared its name with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] as well as its predominantly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] inhabitants.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] was mentioned in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''. In the [[Datalog/Legends|datalog]], an advertisement for [[Meredex Atmospherics]]' [[EMS-90 Bubble Cloak|EMS-90 bubble cloak]] quipped that, while it might be a tight fit inside the inflatable, [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]-proof emergency coccoon, it would allow its wearer to survive to complain about it over Chandrilan [[Plant/Legends|herb]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]].<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chandrilan herb tea was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
